I have farmed this small plot near my house for many years, and it grows enset and some fruit trees that my family depends on. We always put cow manure and compost around the plants because that is what my father taught me, but I do not buy chemical fertilizer or new seeds from the market. My children and grandchildren help with the weeding and harvesting, so we do not need to hire outside workers for this plot.
